metric_definitions.cisd: 1 - mean cosine similarity over the 10 unordered caption pairs; higher means more separated.
metric_definitions.nn_redundancy: Mean over captions of the maximum cosine similarity to another caption; lower means less local duplication.
metric_definitions.effective_rank_norm: exp(entropy of squared singular-value spectrum of centered 5x512 embeddings) / 4.
metric_definitions.grounding_mean: Mean cosine similarity between the image embedding and the five caption embeddings.
metric_definitions.grounding_min: Minimum image-caption cosine similarity within the five captions.
